summary.text: Christopher Dardzinski, a U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 13th District to Donavan McKinney.

He had appeared on the general-election ballot for this seat before, and Ballotpedia lists his career as including business, publishing, writing, economic analysis, political consulting and journalism.

paragraphs.text: Dardzinski was born in Wyandotte, Michigan, in 1967 and raised there, according to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, and he earned an associate degree from Henry Ford Community College in 1988.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working in business and as a publisher, author, economic analyst, political consultant and journalist; in a 2024 survey he described himself as a former city council member and retired international trade analyst.
Dardzinski appeared on the general-election ballot for Michigan's 13th District as the U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate in 2022 and 2024, and he advanced from the party's July 18, 2026 convention.
He received 1.0% of the vote to Donavan McKinney's 76.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
